::: notes
The last session of the course is mostly yours. You declared one analysis yesterday, in the preregistration block of Task 5, and ran it. This afternoon you turn that work into a short report of your own. First the folder of the workspace becomes a git repository, and the very first thing that it records is your preregistration as it stands. Then you write the report around the declared analysis, in four parts, with every number computed by the report itself. Then you render it from a clean session, so that you know it runs for anyone, and you commit each step as you go. Publishing the report on the web is an option at the end, for those who want it. I talk for a few slides at the start of each stage, and then the time is yours.
:::
